A more direct recovery mechanism has emerged: acquire coherent logical controls from a few forward calibration states, rather than reconstruct a full channel or dilation. One version uses complementary logical observables; another uses a single polar operator built from the partially transposed Choi state.

I’m working through the recovery guarantee and full access costs. The separate foundational line has also produced a proposed obstruction to the entire class of constant-coefficient linear flows.
